# Kerllos Ayad – Shopify Developer in Cairo, Egypt

> Kerllos Ayad is a Shopify developer and Senior Frontend Engineer (Angular) in Cairo, Egypt, building Shopify stores for brands in Egypt and the Middle East.

Kerllos Ayad is a Shopify developer and Senior Frontend Engineer based in Cairo, Egypt, with 4+ years of experience. Current role: Senior Frontend Engineer at MCV (Manufacturing Commercial Vehicles). Serves clients in Egypt and Middle East.

## Services
- Shopify store setup & design
- Custom Shopify themes & features
- Speed & SEO optimization
- Web apps & landing pages

## Skills
Shopify, Liquid, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, UI/UX
